blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.
blocks.zh: 重量-空间编程通过一级编辑W'=W + u v^T的MLP输出矩阵来去除一个小推理模型的思维回路,其中u是一个回路方向并v是一个稀疏的线性程序(LP)在神经元活化上的解决办法. 我们调查是否需要LP. 我们把它取而代之: 我们取取出8个神经元, 这些神经元的活化系数是最小的, 并给予它们LP溶液所实现的推力的等分量。 在 Quen3.5-0.8B 时 在1000个问题(MATH-500和GSM8K)上排序的编辑分数为67.0%,而LP编辑分数为67.4%,未经编辑的模型分数为9.5%;在跑前宣布的5分的非绝对差值内,对接的分数为-0.4分,置信间隔为95%[-2.9,+2.1]。 在另外三个采样种子上,当剂量设定为无LP时,相差为-0.6分,相差为-2.0分,+0.8分;相差为-0.8分,相差为-2.3分,+0.6分. 该类不解LP,但其与LP溶液共用的神经元携带了它的多数正推. 结果是,在这个模型上,编辑在u身上几乎是一成不变的偏差.

blocks.en:
The LPs are not small, and they are dense. In our run of AHA on Qwen3.5-0.8B, the LP of each layer has
12 000 constraint rows (4000 looping and 8000 productive tokens, the latter with a two-sided
constraint), 3584 variables v j v_{j} (the width of the MLP) plus one slack per row, and a dense constraint
matrix with about 43 million nonzeros. It is solved twice per layer, on all neurons and then on the 8
selected ones, for each of the 20 layers on which AHA solves it. Note that the optimum of the first
solve is very sparse: between 6 and 189 nonzero v j v_{j} out of 3584. With the GPU implementation of the
primal-dual hybrid gradient method (PDHG) shipped with AHA, the search of a layer, essentially the two
solves, takes 3 to 11 seconds, about 2.2 minutes over the 20 layers, on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000
Blackwell. By contrast, the sort of Section 2 needs two moments per neuron, i.e., one pass over the
activations of the fit tokens.

At first glance, this is a separation model: push the looping tokens, leave the productive ones
alone. However, the solutions do not separate. On our fit rows the LP edit pushes the looping tokens by − 0.79 -0.79 and the productive ones by − 0.70 -0.70 at layer 15 ( − 0.89 -0.89 and − 0.83 -0.83 at layer 19), with a
coefficient of variation of the push of 0.21 0.21 ( 0.12 0.12 ). The public sweep of [ 2 ] tells the
same story: multiplying δ \delta by 2 or by 8 leaves the accuracy unchanged, whereas ε = 0.25 \varepsilon=0.25 destroys it. Hence the LP synthesizes a bias along u u , by using neurons that are almost always active.

blocks.en: 2 The sort
blocks.zh: 2个 这种

For each neuron j j we compute the mean m j m_{j} and the standard deviation σ j \sigma_{j} of h j h_{j} on the fit
rows, with the class weights of the LP. We call sort_k8 the edit defined by the k = 8 k=8 neurons
with smallest σ j / | m j | \sigma_{j}/|m_{j}| and by the weights v j := c / ( k ​ m j ) v_{j}:=c/(k\,m_{j}) , where the dose c c is the mean
push of the LP solution on the same rows. Note that the dose is borrowed from the LP on purpose, so
that the two edits differ in the neurons and not in the dose; the window of useful doses is known to be
narrow [ 2 ] . As a control we also consider knap_k8 , that takes the 8 neurons with
largest | m j | |m_{j}| (the continuous knapsack rule, variance ignored). No solve is involved: two moments
per neuron and a sort.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en:
We ran the unmodified AHA pipeline (commit e6e94ff5 ) on Qwen3.5-0.8B with layers 15 and 19
fixed, on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, with one sample per problem. The protocol, the arms
and the verdict rule were committed before any number was produced.

固定,在单 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell上,每个问题有一个样本. 协议 武器
并且判决规则是在任何数字出现之前作出的。

blocks.en: Sampling seeds
blocks.zh: 采样种子

blocks.en:
After seeing the outcome of seed 0 we declared a second protocol, again before the runs: the same
edits, rebuilt from the stored u u and v v , evaluated with three new sampling seeds. Note that the
seeds measure the sampling noise on fixed edits; they do not replicate the pipeline that produces u u and the LP solution. The second protocol adds one arm, sortd_k8 , with the neurons and the
shares of sort_k8 but with dose c := − δ c:=-\delta , where δ \delta is computed by AHA from u u before any LP is solved. Hence sortd_k8 takes nothing from the LP solution. For every problem
we average the correctness over the three seeds, and the standard error is computed over the 1000
problems.

blocks.en:
We did not test a constant shift along u u at the same dose. On a development set of 128 problems, the
sweep of [ 2 ] reports 57.8% for such a steering against 62.5% for the LP edit, a gap within
the noise of 128 problems but in the direction of the LP; hence “nearly constant” is the right word, and a steering arm is the
natural next control.
blocks.zh:
我们没有在同一剂量下 测试一个不停的转变。 关于128个发展问题,
扫描[2]号报告,57.8%用于这种指导,62.5%用于LP编辑,这是内部的空白
128个问题的噪音,但朝LP的方向发出;因此,“近乎恒定”一词是正确的,方向臂是
自然的下一个控制。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown that, on Qwen3.5-0.8B, a sort of the neurons by coefficient of variation matches the LP
of weight-space programming over three sampling seeds (difference − 0.6 -0.6 points, interval [ − 2.0 , + 0.8 ] [-2.0,\,+0.8] ), without any solver. The dose,
a single scalar per layer, can be taken from the threshold δ \delta that AHA computes before the LP.
Admittedly, we tested one model and one run of the pipeline that produces u u . In our view the informative part of the AHA edit is the
direction u u , not the LP that implements it.

在三个采样种子上进行权重空间编程(偏差−0.6-0.6分,间隔[−2.0,+0.8] [-2.0,\,+0.8]),无任何解析器. 剂量,
每层可取出AHA在LP前计算出的 \\ delta 阈值。
无可否认,我们测试了一个模型 和运行的管道生产uu。 我们认为,AHA编辑的信息部分是:
方向 u u , 不是执行它的 LP 。

blocks.en: Role of AI
blocks.zh: 大赦国际的作用

blocks.en:
This note was produced with an AI assistant, and we prefer to state the division of labor plainly.
The idea is the author’s: the LP of [ 2 ] looked like a knapsack in disguise, hence its
solution might be replaced by a sort. The author also supervised the work, decided what to run and
what to publish, and takes responsibility for the content. Everything else was done by Claude
(Anthropic; models Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, used within Claude Code): reading the material of AHA and
of [ 2 ] , the choice of the sorting key and of the dose, the two protocols, the code, the runs
on the cluster, the statistical analysis, and the text of this note, including this section. The
whole work took one day, 16 November 2026.
blocks.zh:
这份说明是用人工智能助理制作的,我们更愿意明确说明劳动分工.
这个想法是作者的:[2]的LP在伪装中看起来像一个背包,因此它
解决办法可以被某种方式取代。 提交人也监督了这项工作,决定开展哪些工作,
出版内容, 并负责内容。 其他一切都是克劳德做的
(Anthropic;模型Fable 5.2和Opus 5.5, Claude Code使用):读取AHA的材料和
[2], 排序键和剂量的选择, 两个协议,代码,运行
统计分析,以及本说明的案文,包括本节。 那个
整个工作花了一天时间,2026年11月16日。
